integrity: Proof is analytic for every admissible dimension and time. Exact rational projector identities and independent matrix-exponential consistency checks are supplied. Novelty is assessed against specific examined works, not proven by database nonmatches; independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted complete bipartite graphs with both part sizes at least two; the unnormalized combinatorial Laplacian squared; unweighted vertex sup norm; no generalization to arbitrary graphs, different weights, or normalized Laplacians.
title: Sharp positivity recovery and transient amplification on unbalanced complete bipartite graphs
